title: Cherry Villages! (Mot's Structures)
description: This mod/datapack adds not-so-complex - vanilla like structures into the game using only vanilla blocks that already are in the game.
body:
This datapack adds not-so-complex - vanilla like structures that aim to look like they fit in with the rest of the world and feel like they belong there. 

Custom textures info:
This mod uses a map chart system like the one in DnT aswell as custom trail keys.

Datapack:
To give the custom textures to the charts and keys, you'll need to download the recourcepack and load it.
If they still apear to be missing, try loading it again at the top of the active recourcepack list.

Mod loaders:
The mod already gives custom textures to charts and keys, so if they apear to be missing, try loading the mod with higher priority in your mod list or dowload and activate the recourcepack.

![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59aa65b76b93733ba60b0267aef5c49b90b7ca2a.png)

This mod/datapack is in an early stage of development. Expect things to change.
